valueString.value: Qualifying Encounter During Measurement Period

define "Qualifying Encounter During Measurement Period": ( [Encounter: "Encounter Inpatient"] union [Encounter: "Emergency Department Visit"] union [Encounter: "Observation Services"] union [Encounter: class in {"emergency", "inpatient acute", "inpatient encounter", "inpatient non-acute", "short stay"}]) QualifyingEncounters where QualifyingEncounters.status in {'in-progress', 'finished', 'triaged', 'onleave', 'entered-in-error'} and QualifyingEncounters.period overlaps "Measurement Period"
Encounters with Patient Hospital Locations

define "Encounters with Patient Hospital Locations": [Encounter] Encounters where exists( Encounters.location EncounterLocation where Global.GetLocation(EncounterLocation.location).type in "Inpatient, Emergency, and Observation Locations" and EncounterLocation.period overlaps Encounters.period and Encounters.status in {'in-progress', 'finished', 'triaged', 'onleave', 'entered-in-error'} )
Initial Population
define "Initial Population": "Qualifying Encounter During Measurement Period" union "Encounters with Patient Hospital Locations"
SDE Encounter

define "SDE Encounter": [Encounter] Encounters where exists("Initial Population") return SharedResource.EncounterResource(Encounters, {FHIR.canonical{value: 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-encounter'}})
SDE Medication Request

define "SDE Medication Request": [MedicationRequest] MedicationRequests where exists("Initial Population") return SharedResource.MedicationRequestResource(MedicationRequests, {FHIR.canonical{value: 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-medicationrequest'}})
SDE Coverage
define "SDE Coverage": [Coverage] Coverages where exists("Initial Population") return SharedResource.CoverageResourceBaseFHIR(Coverages)
SDE Procedure

define "SDE Procedure": [Procedure] Procedures where exists("Initial Population") return SharedResource.ProcedureResource(Procedures, {FHIR.canonical{value: 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-procedure'}})
SDE DiagnosticReport All
define "SDE DiagnosticReport All": [DiagnosticReport] DiagnosticReports where exists("Initial Population") return SharedResource.DiagnosticReportResourceBaseFHIR(DiagnosticReports)
SDE Device
define "SDE Device": [Device] Devices where exists("Initial Population") return SharedResource.DeviceResourceBaseFHIR(Devices)
SDE Observation Lab Category

define "SDE Observation Lab Category": [Observation] Observations where (exists(Observations.category Category where Category ~ "laboratory")) and exists("Initial Population") return SharedResource.ObservationResource(Observations, {FHIR.canonical{value: 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-observation-lab'}})
SDE Observation Vital Signs Category

//Vital Signs Observation has its own profile in FHIR Base define "SDE Observation Vital Signs Category": [Observation] Observations where (exists(Observations.category Category where Category ~ "vital-signs")) and exists("Initial Population") return SharedResource.ObservationResource(Observations, {FHIR.canonical{value: 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/vitalsigns'}})
SDE Medication Administration

define "SDE Medication Administration": [MedicationAdministration] MedicationAdministrations where exists("Initial Population") return SharedResource.MedicationAdministrationResourceBaseFHIR(MedicationAdministrations)
SDE Observation Category

//Defaulting to base FHIR profile as there are no individual profiles in US Core 3.1.1 that cover these Observation categories define "SDE Observation Category": [Observation] Observations where ((exists(Observations.category Category where Category ~ "social-history")) or (exists(Observations.category Category where Category ~ "survey")) or (exists(Observations.category Category where Category ~ "imaging")) or (exists(Observations.category Category where Category ~ "procedure"))) and exists("Initial Population") return SharedResource.ObservationResourceBaseFHIR(Observations)
SDE Initial Population Encounters

define "SDE Initial Population Encounters": "Initial Population" IP return SharedResource.EncounterResource(IP, {FHIR.canonical{value: 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-encounter'}})
SDE Condition
SDE DiagnosticReport Lab

define "SDE DiagnosticReport Lab": [DiagnosticReport] DiagnosticReports where (exists(DiagnosticReports.category Category where Category ~ "LAB") and exists("Initial Population")) return SharedResource.DiagnosticReportResource(DiagnosticReports, {FHIR.canonical{value: 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-diagnosticreport-lab'}})
SDE Location

define "SDE Location": [Location] Locations where exists("Initial Population") return SharedResource.LocationResource(Locations, {FHIR.canonical{value: 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-location'}})
SDE Service Request
define "SDE Service Request": [ServiceRequest] ServiceRequests where exists("Initial Population") return SharedResource.ServiceRequestResourceBaseFHIR(ServiceRequests)
SDE DiagnosticReport Note

define "SDE DiagnosticReport Note": [DiagnosticReport] DiagnosticReports where ((exists(DiagnosticReports.category Category where Category ~ "Radiology")) or exists((DiagnosticReports.category Category where Category ~ "Pathology")) or exists((DiagnosticReports.category Category where Category ~ "Cardiology"))) and exists("Initial Population") return SharedResource.DiagnosticReportResource(DiagnosticReports, {FHIR.canonical{value: 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-diagnosticreport-note'}})
SDE Minimal Patient
define "SDE Minimal Patient": Patient p return SharedResource.PatientResource(p, {FHIR.canonical{value: 'http://www.cdc.gov/nhsn/fhirportal/dqm/ig/StructureDefinition/cross-measure-patient'}})
SDE Medication

define "SDE Medication": [Medication] Medication where exists("Initial Population") return SharedResource.MedicationResource(Medication, {FHIR.canonical{value: 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-medication'}})
SDE Specimen
define "SDE Specimen": [Specimen] Specimen where exists("Initial Population") return SharedResource.SpecimenResourceBaseFHIR(Specimen)

title.value: NHSN dQM Acute Care Hospital Initial Population

description.value: The Acute Care Hospital Initial Population includes all encounters for patients of any age in an ED, observation, or inpatient location or all encounters for patients of any age with an ED, observation, inpatient, or short stay status during the measurement period.

rationale.value:
The NHSN Acute Care Hospital dQM allows for facilities to report line level patient data electronically to NHSN for the following modules that are reported monthly:
* Glycemic Control, Hypoglycemia * Healthcare facility-onset, antibiotic-Treated Clostridioides difficile (C. difficile) Infection (HT-CDI) * Hospital-Onset Bacteremia & Fungemia (HOB) * Venous Thromboembolism (VTE) * Late Onset Sepsis / Meningitis
*Please see [Acute Care / Critical Access Hospitals (ACH) | NHSN | CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/nhsn/acute-care-hospital/index.html) for the individual measure protocols
